about.beta_body: This is an open-beta build (OB1.0.0). Features may still change or need a tweak on your side. Provided as-is — the author is not on the hook for lost data or unexpected downtime. Keep backups, use sensible passwords, and look after your own host and network. Try it, break it kindly, and tell us what to improve.
about.bug_body: Tell me what exploded. Screenshots are pure gold.
about.changelog.api: REST API v1: Mga endpoint na naka-key auth sa ilalim ng parehong permission model, para sa integrasyon sa iba pang sistema sa shop floor.
about.changelog.assets: Asset register na may physical labels: Buong OEM/warranty/lifecycle records, at QR & DataMatrix label printing — offline payloads para sa Zebra o sheet printer, walang internet.
about.changelog.design: Unified design system: Isang token-driven na hitsura sa bawat module — AA-contrast text, iisang modal/button/badge family, totoong Light/Dark, at WebGL background na maaaring i-off sa lumang machine.
about.changelog.inventory: Inventory na may totoong ledger: Bawat galaw — ticket consumption, work-order consumption, PO receipt — naitatala at masusubaybayan pabalik sa trabahong sanhi nito.
about.changelog.notif: Notifications at audit trail: Per-user alerts para sa approvals, low stock at overdue work, na may immutable audit log.
about.changelog.procurement: Procurement hanggang dulo: Requisition → cost approval → storekeeper fulfilment → goods receipt → budget reconciliation, na may nine-stage stepper at buong status history.
about.changelog.rbac: Granular RBAC: 24 permissions across 6 editable roles, enforced server-side on every page and API endpoint — including separate tooling rights and a Storekeeper who can fulfil orders but never approve their cost.
about.changelog.reorder: Event-driven auto-reorder: Ang consumption na bumababa sa minimum ay awtomatikong gumagawa ng requisition, sa parehong approval rules gaya ng manual.
about.changelog.security: Hardened by default: CSRF sa state changes, prepared statements, session-fixation at brute-force defences, at Evil Maid locks na nagbubuklod ng takeover at closeout sa authenticated user.
about.changelog.tickets: Kumpletong ticket lifecycle: Register → takeover → logged actions → closeout → searchable history, na may oras sa bawat hakbang para masukat ang MTTA at MTTR, hindi tantyahin.
about.changelog.ux: Device-aware UX: Awtomatikong handheld mode — tables ay nagiging cards, calendar ay nagiging agenda, at touch targets ay lumalaki para sa shop gloves.
about.changelog.wo: Work orders at preventive maintenance: Umuulit na schedules, reusable checklists, calendar view, at overdue detection.
about.chat_body: Ideas, questions, or plant-floor war stories — all welcome.
about.feat.analytics_body: Nagsasama-sama ng intervention telemetry para kalkulahin ang Mean Time To Repair (MTTR), subaybayan ang downtime, workload ng technician, at parts consumption sa paglipas ng panahon.
about.feat.assets_body: Pinapanatili ang core CMMS entity structure sa pamamagitan ng self-referential hierarchy. Ang machines at sub-assemblies ay naka-link sa spare parts sa pamamagitan ng Bill of Materials (BOM) routing.
about.feat.docs_body: Secure storage para sa Safety SOPs, technical manuals, at blueprints. Mahigpit na MIME validation at isolated paths para laging accessible ang safety-critical documents mula sa asset page.
about.feat.inventory_body: Sinusubaybayan ang logistics data, stock levels, at compliance fields. Zero-touch auto-reorder kapag bumaba ang stock sa threshold.
about.feat.lines: Production lines at shop floor hierarchies
about.feat.lines_body: Buong hierarchy management mula workshop hanggang line hanggang equipment. Ang production lines ay first-class citizens na may machine counts, status tracking, at direktang integrasyon sa work orders at equipment.
about.feat.modular_body: Kumpletong reorganisasyon sa logical domain folders (_mgmt, _maint, _eam, _prod, _logi, _rpt atbp.) para sa maintainability at expansion. Na-update ang lahat ng references, includes, at navigation.
about.feat.pm_body: Proactive scheduling engine para sa Preventive Maintenance (PM). Awtomatikong sinusubaybayan ang overdue routines, ina-adjust ang plant holidays, at ipinapakita ang workload sa interactive calendar.
about.feat.procurement_body: Kinocoordinate ang buong acquisition chain. Ang internal PR ay umaangat bilang pormal na PO sa vendors, na may IATF-compliant audit log sa 9 na PO statuses.
about.feat.rbac_body: Enterprise-grade permission system para sa ganap na seguridad. Mula sa granular module access hanggang Evil Maid Protection laban sa unauthorized session hijacking sa ticket takeovers at closeouts.
about.feat.tickets_body: Namamahala ng industrial faults mula sa unang registry hanggang assignment ng technician at final resolution. Sumusuporta sa direct entry para sa mabilisang pag-aayos.
about.indykb_blurb: Ginawa para sa mga technician na nagbabahagi ng kaalaman sa aming hanay, at libre para sa sinuman sa mundo na kailangang panatilihing gumagalaw ang production lines.

about.privacy_body: WCC is built for local / on-prem installs. It does not phone home, and it does not collect your plant data for anyone else. Tickets, assets, users, and files live in your database on your host. How safe that is depends on your own network, firewall, accounts, and backups — not on a cloud we control, because there isn’t one.
about.privacy_title: Runs on your machine — your data stays yours
about.release_intro: Open beta OB1.0.0 — the modules below are built, wired end to end, and exercised on plant-style data. Expect polish as the beta matures.
about.welcome: Maligayang pagdating sa Workshop Control Center (WCC). Hindi ito isa pang mabigat na enterprise software na idinisenyo sa boardroom—ito ay high-performance, framework-free CMMS na hinubog sa mismong factory floor. Ginawa ng mga technician at engineer, PARA sa mga technician at engineer, tinatanggal ng WCC ang corporate dead weight para ibigay ang talagang mahalaga: ganap na bilis ng execution. Dinisenyo para tumakbo sa edge, sinisira nito ang information gatekeeping, at inilalagay sa inyong mga kamay ang mga kasangkapan para pamahalaan ang buong ticket lifecycle, subaybayan ang mahalagang inventory, at suriin ang real-time KPIs.
